evidence.t: Deer here are black tailed deer, the coast form of mule deer: the synopsis calls them "mule (black-tailed) deer" (99%, Rule Book: Region 2 Lower Mainland).
Mule deer winter range u-2-011 unit SC 01 (official), right here. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHdm2): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
W facing slope, 35 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 390 m NW: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Private land 390 m NW: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

Hwy 101 (Sunshine Coast Hwy) 200 m W: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from District of Squamish, about 77 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.70013, -123.96141, pull off on Hwy 101 (Sunshine Coast Hwy) (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 200 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 110 m, about 15 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2020 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-5, Region 2. Season: mule deer bucks Sept 10 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 28, 99%). 3 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R2B-deer-drive-0004.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 2-5: about 1,590 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.46 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
